summary: An integer or decimal SUM that fits its type on a proved row bound is proved exact in colEps, via the single check Measure.sumFits (intSumExact removed); window sums and iavg stay unproved.
note: 'Amends the scope of ruling 85.' Addendum (same day) accepts the S3 deviation with T1-T3 and corrects the user notice (SUM columns are not in Report.epsilon). No D-number.
